race.comment: AUSTRALASIA (6) gets top billing after going under by only a neck at this track last week, and her Gold Coast run prior had merit after racing wide throughout and making ground. Gary Geran returns after winning on her at their only pairing, which strengthens the case. BOLE LE (1) is the main danger on consistency, having placed in CL3 here and CL2 at Ipswich at his past two, and the drop back to BM58 company reads well despite the top weight. MONDELLO (8) had genuine excuses when held up and interfered with behind AUSTRALASIA last week, and her track-and-trip record keeps her firmly in the mix. WATER LAD (7) was only beaten just under two lengths in BM55 company at Beaudesert and has enough 1300m grounding to be competitive.
